arguments.text: Original conjecture remains open in this study. Investigate n=24t+1, t>=1, x=6t+1, b=nx. Conjecture for this route: 3/b=1/y+1/z is solvable in positive integers iff b has a prime divisor q=2 mod 3. First attack boundary cases, then prove both directions and exact construction. Compare with unrestricted witnesses; a greedy obstruction is not a conjecture counterexample. Novelty not assessed.
